CAMERA.still: 固定镜头，画面稳定，仅保留自然的微小运动。
CAMERA.push: 镜头缓慢推进，保持主体居中且运动连续。
CAMERA.pull: 镜头缓慢拉远，逐步显露环境关系。
CAMERA.pan: 镜头平稳横移，速度均匀，不要突然变焦。
CAMERA.orbit: 镜头轻微环绕主体，运动克制并保持身份稳定。

MOTION.subtle: 主体只有呼吸、眨眼、发丝和衣摆等细微运动。
MOTION.natural: 主体做一个清晰、自然、连续的动作，避免反复和突变。
MOTION.expressive: 主体动作更有表现力，但肢体结构和身份始终保持一致。

H3_CAMERA.still: The camera holds a static shot.
H3_CAMERA.push: The camera pushes in at a slow, steady pace.
H3_CAMERA.pull: The camera pulls out at a slow, steady pace.
H3_CAMERA.pan: The camera pans steadily to the side, without abrupt zooms.
H3_CAMERA.orbit: The camera arcs around the subject with restrained motion, keeping the composition stable.

H3_MOTION.subtle: The subject moves only subtly: breathing, blinking, hair and clothing swaying.
H3_MOTION.natural: The subject performs one clear, natural, continuous action, avoiding repetition or abrupt changes.
H3_MOTION.expressive: The subject's action is more expressive while body structure and identity stay consistent.

wide.label: 全景
wide.line: The scene is framed as a wide establishing shot with the full environment visible.

medium.label: 中景
medium.line: The subject is framed in a medium shot from the waist up.

closeup.label: 特写
closeup.line: The subject is framed in a close-up on the face.

prose.H3_SOUNDSCAPE: Quiet ambient room tone with subtle movement sounds — soft fabric rustle and gentle breathing; no dialogue, no voiceover.
prose.H3_MUSIC: Soft piano notes at a slow tempo joined by sustained low strings, volume gently rising then fading at the end.
